Phase 1 — Foundation & Test Structure | Site: SauceDemo

As a QA learner, I want to automate a failed login attempt using a locked-out user so that I can verify the exact error message and confirm the URL does not change.

## Acceptance Criteria

AC1: A second it block is added to login.cy.ts for the negative login scenario.

AC2: Login is attempted using the username locked_out_user with any password input.

AC3: A cy.url().should('not.include', 'inventory') assertion confirms the URL has not changed after the failed login.

AC4: The error message container is queried and a .then(($el) => { ... }) callback is used with an explicit expect($el.text()).to.equal('Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.') assertion.

AC5: Test passes in the Cypress Test Runner.

## Learning Goal
Learn how to test failure states and use explicit BDD assertions.

## References
- Site: https://www.saucedemo.com/
